**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no restrictive covenant on the AP. Beyond the absence of any non-compete, § 1 (p0001) affirmatively works in our favour:

> "Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties."

Checks performed across the full text: competing-business/"compete" language, exclusivity, "restrict", solicitation, "shall/will not develop/market/sell/offer/engage", field-of-use, territory, and "similar services". The only hits were ordinary confidentiality (p0059, p0060) and license-scope terms (p0002 — non-exclusive, non-transferable, no sublicense), which limit our use of Kubient's own Auction Platform rather than our freedom to operate our business, buy competing services, or build our own. That is standard licence scope, not a field-of-use restriction, so it is not flagged.

This satisfies the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no narrowed fallback is needed.
